text:
Tara Nguyen: Quick thread — new TypeScript monorepo starter (next-ts-monorepo) is tripping the eval harness. Seems to be a combo of SDK typing differences, auth retry behavior, and telemetry hooks that mutate request headers during retries. Repro steps below.

Tara Nguyen: Local repro: git clone examples/next-ts-monorepo && pnpm -w && pnpm dev in examples/web, set REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_TEST_EXPIRE_MS=800, then call /api/generate. Sometimes get 401 and the telemetry middleware injects a trace-id after the retry which the server rejects as a malformed header -> 400.

Ben Holt: saw this in CI too on the linux runner. Failing test is tests/eval/parity/telemetry. Log excerpt: "AuthError: 401 -> retry -> RequestError: invalid header 'x-rw-trace'"

Iris Morgan: snippet from apps/web/pages/api/generate.ts:```ts
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const out = await rwClient.text.generate({ prompt: req.body.prompt });
  res.json(out);
}
```

Iris Morgan: our SDK's telemetry plugin mutates headers in-place and doesn't deep-copy opts on retry. So when a retry happens it appends another trace-id entry instead of replacing.

Daniel Cho: also discovered TS issue: SDK types define headers as Record<string,string> but examples pass Headers object in fetch shim. Type mismatch leads to implicit toString in some runners which concatenates values with commas, causing server-side parse errors.

Kai Wu: root cause summary: 1) auth refresh queues requests but uses same opts.headers object; 2) telemetry middleware appends trace header instead of setting; 3) some runtimes stringify Headers differently on retry -> malformed header.

Tara Nguyen: minimal repro patch added to repo: examples/next-ts-monorepo/tests/fixtures/telemetry-retry.js that forces expiry and asserts single x-rw-trace header. I'll open a PR with failing test.

Ben Holt: proposed fixes: a) SDK: normalize opts on request start (clone headers) b) telemetry: use setHeader semantics not append c) types: widen header types to HeadersInit | Record<string,string> and document runtime caveats.

Iris Morgan: small code suggestion for telemetry middleware:```ts
// telemetry/middleware.ts
return async (next, opts) => {
  const headers = new Headers(opts.headers || {});
  headers.set('x-rw-trace', generateTraceId());
  return next({ ...opts, headers });
}
```

Daniel Cho: also add guard to auth queue: when enqueuing, deepClone opts to avoid mutation races. Simple util: cloneRequestOpts(opts) that clones headers and body if small.

Kai Wu: question — should we auto-retry streams or just fail and surface to app? Monorepo starter has streaming examples (agent runner) and they get aborted mid-retry.

Tara Nguyen: for now make stream endpoints non-resumable and restart once if opts.idempotent === true, documented in starter README. We'll coordinate with eng-runtime on more advanced resumable streams.

devex-bot: CI failure recorded: https://ci.internal.redwood/gh/examples/next-ts-monorepo/5 -> tests/eval/parity -> 2430001155

Ben Holt: I opened a small PR in js-sdk with three changes: clone opts before queuing, widen headers type, and telemetry example update. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/212 (WIP).

Iris Morgan: I pushed a tiny example fix to examples repo to defensive-copy headers before passing to client. Also added unit test to assert header count after retry. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/201

Daniel Cho: added types helper in SDK: export type HeadersInitLike = HeadersInit | Record<string,string> and updated README examples to use new helper. Also added migration note.

Kai Wu: ran local eval harness after applying example patch + SDK clone fix — parity test now passes for telemetry case. Will run full suite tomorrow in CI.

Tara Nguyen: OK will leave the stream resumability caveat in README and add a troubleshooting section: "If you see duplicate headers after retries, ensure middleware uses set() not append() and avoid mutating opts.header objects." 

devex-bot: PRs merged: js-sdk#212, examples#201 at 2430001178. CI rerun enqueued. :shipit:

Ben Holt: follow-up action: add e2e harness fixture that forces token rotation and verifies header hygiene across retries. Also add a quick TS lint rule to forbid headers.append in middleware folder.

Iris Morgan: filing an issue in docs repo to add a page on "middlewares and retries" with best practices. Will link to example code.

Tara Nguyen: thanks everyone — closing this thread. If parity pops up again for other starters ping me and I'll repro with the monorepo harness.
